citations.field: 比部; PDF p. 738, printed p. 725; 董莲池’s formation and meaning account
citations.text: 董莲池 proposes an ideographic construction from two 匕, described as ancient shallow, long-handled food ladles with pointed ends. The entry says juxtaposing them expresses nearness or adjacency and explicitly says 匕 also cues the pronunciation. It treats “密也” from Shuowen as semantically compatible but rejects Shuowen’s two-person/reversed-从 analysis. It proposes extension from adjacency/nearness to union, factional association and comparison, and cites a Shang oracle-bone phrase 王比望乘伐下危 as using 比 for union. These are the author’s analyses, not independently settled conclusions. The exact printed component named in the sound clause is 匕.

consulted_citations.field: 比部; PDF p. 738, printed p. 725; 比 headword, glyph sequence and account; continuation checked on PDF p. 739, printed p. 726
consulted_citations.text: The printed headword is 比. The entry labels forms 商、西周、《說文》古文、秦、《說文》小篆、漢 and 楷書, and describes its main line as retaining a two-匕 construction from Shang–Zhou through small seal, with an exception among the ancient forms. It says clerical transformation straightened the strokes and obscured their pictorial quality. I inspected both attached page images; p. 726 begins 北部 and does not continue 比. The printed page numbers 725 and 726 are visible in the scans. Edition metadata is identified separately by the linked catalogue; it does not support the interpretation.

consulted_citations.field: 比部; PDF p. 738, printed p. 725; cited examples and semantic interpretation
consulted_citations.text: The entry cites 《詩·周頌·良耜》“其比如栉” for its proposed adjacency sense; an oracle-bone phrase “辛酉卜，争贞：王比望乘伐下危？” for union; 《论语·为政》“君子周而不比” for factional association; and 《左传·昭公二十八年》 for comparison. This documents the book’s semantic analysis and examples, not a securely dated chain of semantic development. Its graphic-sequence references are 《甲金篆》 p. 571 and 《说文》 p. 169.
